description: Xeon Phi 3120A/3120P (57 cores, 1.1 GHz, 6 GB GDDR5, 240 GB/s peak). Only Intel's published card constants are filled in. Latencies that the common profile leaves unknown stay unknown here, so simulations that need them stop with missing_parameter until measurements are imported.
